question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page = 5 AND (text ILIKE '%306%' OR text ILIKE '%370 mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%1500%')) OR (page = 6 AND text ILIKE '%1C%') ORDER BY id

SELECT 100.0 * CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L87'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS share
